full_judgment:
34. Countering contention, it has been contended from side of State that vital witnesses had been examined and any adverse presumption cannot arise. Non-examination of wife of informant PW I and son and daughter of both deceased and condemned prisoner did not destroy trustworthiness of prosecution case, it is further submitted. 

 "The prosecution is not bound to produce a witness if he is not expected to give true evidence even though he may have been mentioned in the charge-sheet or First Information Report. If a prosecutor considers that a witness would depose falsely there would be justification for not examining him. If the prosecution collected all material witnesses and named them in the charge-sheet and examined some of them and did not examine the remaining charge-sheeted witnesses, in our opinion, no adverse presumption should be drawn in the case."
